names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Ρωμανός ο Κίλικας ο θαυματουργός», with the rank word left off.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1873, «Роман Антиохийский (Сирийский), отшельник», with the trailing grade and the alternative by-name left off; its life page 3236 is titled «Преподобный Роман Антиохийский». The day line gives only «Романа чудотворца», the wonderworker, with no by-name at all.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 27. новембар ст. ст., „Преп. Роман чудотворац.“ — «Преп.» is Преподобни, the `venerable` grade this folder already keeps, and «чудотворац» is Чудотворац, the `wonderworker` grade it also keeps, so both rank words come off and the heading prints nothing else at all: Antioch is in the body, so there was no «Роман Антиохијски» on the page to copy and none was constructed. The bare forename therefore stands, and it was measured before it was written: it joins the SIX-MEMBER fold the Serbian wave keyed on 7 October 2026, which is widened to seven in this commit with the whole of its earlier reading carried forward and the narrower key deleted in the same pass.

feast.note: The Greek keeps him on 9 February and this calendar on 27 November; his name page 1873 gives «День памяти: 27 ноября» and no other day, so the two churches simply keep one man on two days.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Романа чудотворца (V).»

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.12.2025 (27. новембар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Роман чудотворац.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, FIVE SHORT SENTENCES. HE IS THE ANTIOCHENE AND NOT ANOTHER ROMAN: the entry puts him «у околини Антиохије», in the country round Antioch, which is the see the folder’s own Russian form carries — «Роман Антиохийский» — on the same menologion number the Russian calendar keeps him on, and the cell without fire and the help given to barren women are this folder’s dossier and no other’s. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book gives no year, no reign and no century, so the «5th century» this folder reads off the Russian calendar’s Roman numeral stands untouched and unconfirmed. No `related` row: the entry names nobody. No `locations`: the folder has none and Antioch is given as the country round a city and not as a place he was fixed at for a bounded span. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: the asceticism in the country round Antioch; THE CELL IN WHICH HE NEVER ONCE LIT A FIRE OR A CANDLE; the peaceful end; and that he was a wonderworker in his life and after it and helps barren women who pray to him. NOTE FOR THE AUTHOR: this folder’s Greek row stands on 9 February and its Russian on 27 November, and this book agrees with the Russian.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes both its line and its life with the same Roman numeral where a year would stand — «Прп. Романа чудотворца (V).» and «Достигнув глубокой старости, он с миром отошел ко Господу (V)» — so the century is the whole of the dating. saint.gr prints no year for him at all. The interval is the whole of the century and no year inside it is chosen.
